title: ContractsCommand
responsibility: Registers stored-contract lookup, semantic diff, committed log and last-change CLI commands, flags and read-only output actions.

inputs.name: ContractsCommand.register.program
inputs.description: Commander instance to which the contracts group and its seven subcommands are attached; registration itself performs no registry I/O.

outputs.name: ContractsCommand.register
outputs.description: Returns no value; mutates the Commander tree to install contracts help, validation and asynchronous output actions.

errors.name: InvalidArgumentError
errors.description: Installed CLI parsers reject a limit token unless it is a positive safe integer without leading zeros, or a depth token unless it is unsigned decimal digits evaluating to zero through ten.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Installed read-only actions propagate stored document, path, search and missing-target diagnostics.
